Priya CSM: Alert  engagement-monitor: EvergreenHealth trial dropped from ~8k tokens/day to <50 yesterday. Procurement paused pilot. Flagging as renewal risk.
engage-bot: Health-scan: org EvergreenHealth (org_id: ev_221) STATUS=LOW_USAGE risk_score=20/100 flagged_by=engagement-monitor
Daniel AE: They heard a competitor (VendorY) pitched an on-prem appliance yesterday. Main asks: KMS details, SSO + SCIM docs, and latency proof for their document-chunking pipeline.
Priya CSM: Their ML lead called out inconsistent headings in long multi-document summaries and two hallucination examples. Wants sample outputs and proposed mitigations.
Omar Eng: Please share a failing request id and a sanitized prompt so I can repro cache/batching behavior. Could be KV cache TTL or a model-variant mismatch.
Priya CSM: Sample prompt (sanitized):
```
Generate a consolidated executive summary of the past quarter's top 25 incident reports, preserving incident IDs and dates.
```
Request id: ev_req_20240620_11.
Claire Solutions: I uploaded a brief comparing Dedicated+KMS vs Private appliance (ops/cost/turnaround): https://redwood.internal/ev-brief (internal). Can make short slides for exec.
Daniel AE: Suggested plan: 1) Quick 30m technical sync with their ML lead this week; 2) send KMS+SSO checklist and SOC2 summary; 3) offer a 10-day dedicated trial with lowered commit + telemetry; 4) collect 4 failing prompts and run evals. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Priya CSM: +1. I'll gather the 4 prompts and the two hallucination outputs by Tue EOD and loop the exec sponsor.
Omar Eng: I'll run a perf/quality sweep on their pinned model and a small-quant quantized variant tomorrow, capture p50/p95/p99, and attach traces to CS-9102. Will also run a quick hallucination evaluation against the prompt set.
Claire Solutions: If they push for on-prem appliance, we should prep a migration estimate and show Private deployment timeline. If it's KMS-only, Dedicated+KMS is faster. I'll prep both one-pagers.
Daniel AE: I'll draft the re-engagement note and include procurement, security, and the exec sponsor. Priya, once you drop prompts, I'll append logs and Omar's perf summary.
Priya CSM: One ask for the sync: confirm whether VendorY's ask is purely air-gapped hardware or just KMS integration. That changes our playbook.
Daniel AE: Scheduling now. Will post meeting link and attendees.
Priya CSM: Thanks team  will update after call. :white_check_mark:
